note: The few next events shown on the home page; the full calendar at members.thinkiba.com answers 403 to scripts.

name: Out & Equal
note: Workplace-inclusion webinars, forums and the Workplace Summit. Many are for partner companies only.

note: LGBTQ+ people in architecture, engineering and construction. Times on the page are local to each chapter's city.

name: LGBT Tech
note: Technology policy talks and cybersecurity webinars for LGBTQ+ organizations.

note: Pitch sessions, supplier orientations, mixers; mostly online.

name: Out Leadership
note: Business summits and webinars; dates only (the site gives no time zone).
